items.html: However, the Hassadim of the Daat must also spread in the head of ZA, so that the aspect of Daat will be in all the parts of ZA, and also that they will be revealed; for there, in his head, all the lights are closed within the NHY of Tevunah, and the NHY of Tevunah interpose between the Mochin of ZA and the body of ZA itself. Therefore there must be an aspect of revealed Hassadim in all the ten Sefirot of ZA, in order to illuminate all the lights that are closed within him, which are clothed in the partitions of the NHY of Tevunah. And this is the matter of the spreading of these Hassadim and their growth. And understand this rule.
